overview_description.description: Flow solves the complexity of fund infrastructure. We connect information across investors, providers, investments and systems to realize our mission of empowering thought. Powered by dynamic tools and human centric interfaces, our cross platform SaaS technology networks and adapts to the myriad of ways funds operate to optimize productivity and increase time invested into making decisions. By bringing Flow to the $10 Trillion alternative asset market, we are able to increase the speed of decisions, the speed of capital and the speed of growth that serve as the lifeblood for all market based economies.

product.name: Fund Management Software
product.description: A software platform integrating data rooms, investor onboarding, and investor portal solutions to manage private market funds throughout the investment lifecycle.

product.name: Investor Onboarding
product.description: A digital workflow solution that automates and simplifies the subscription process for limited partners investing in private funds.

product.name: Investor Portal
product.description: A centralized platform providing limited partners and service providers with access to fund-related reporting, documentation, and communications.

product.name: Data Rooms
product.description: Virtual data rooms for securely sharing sensitive documents with prospective investors during fundraising.

product.name: Fund Reporting
product.description: Built-in reporting tools that enable fund managers to access, analyze, and export fund and investor data for various reporting needs.
